--LINKREFRESH DECLARE @LAN VARCHAR(30) = '#LOGIN_LAN#'; DECLARE @LANX3 VARCHAR(30) = ( SELECT #LC.X3ERP#GETLANX3(@LAN) ); DECLARE @FCY VARCHAR(5)='{0}'; --ZUPK DECLARE @MFGNUM VARCHAR(50)='{1}'; --MFGZUPK25110003 DECLARE @ITMREF VARCHAR(30)=N'%{2}%'; DECLARE @ITMDES VARCHAR(30)=N'%{3}%';
UPDATE SCS SET SCS.SUBDATIM_0 = Getdate() ,SCS.STAT_0 = 2 ,SCS.BATCHID_0 = '#LINKID_ACTION#' FROM XWSSCS SCS INNER JOIN ITMMASTER ITM ON SCS.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT B.IDENT1_0 AS ITMREF , STRING_AGG(B.TEXTE_0, '') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY B.ZONE_0) AS ITMDES FROM ATEXTRA B WHERE B.CODFIC_0 = 'ITMMASTER' AND B.LANGUE_0 = @LANX3 GROUP BY B.IDENT1_0 ) B ON B.ITMREF = ITM.ITMREF_0 WHERE SCS.USERID_0 = '#LOGIN_USER#' AND SCS.RPFLG_0 <> 3 AND SCS.STOFCY_0 = @FCY AND SCS.STAT_0 = 1 AND SCS.TRSFAM_0 = 'MFGT' AND ITM.ITMREF_0 LIKE Upper(@ITMREF) AND Upper(ISNULL(B.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES1_0)) LIKE Upper(@ITMDES) AND SCS.VCRNUM_0=@MFGNUM
